captures.what_is_new: Commission press release IP/26/2361, 6 Nov 2026: preliminary finding that TikTok is in breach of the Digital Services Act over the 'rabbit hole effect' of its 'For You' feed: it did not adequately assess the risk, and its existing mitigation measures are 'not effective'; the Commission considers TikTok needs to change the feed's design (for example rely more on explicit preferences, disable viewing time as a signal, better controls, regular testing). Next: TikTok may examine the file and reply in writing; the European Board for Digital Services is consulted; if confirmed, a non-compliance decision can trigger a fine of up to 6% of total worldwide annual turnover. 'These preliminary findings do not prejudge the outcome of the investigation.' Ireland's Coimisiun na Mean supported the investigation.

story_candidates.title: The EU says TikTok's For You feed may breach its platform law: what it found, and what happens next
story_candidates.angle: The Commission's preliminary view that TikTok did not adequately assess, and has not effectively reduced, the 'rabbit hole' effect of its recommender system, the changes it says are needed, and the procedure that follows.
